postCosignChecks: Parse DSSE envelope from the exact verified bundle using a maintained parser; do not treat a producer-supplied JSON receipt as authoritative.
Require the exact Statement v1 and predicateType URI.
Require exactly the expected subject name/role and sha256 digest for the artifact bytes.
Require predicate.producer.repositoryId to equal the immutable repository ID from policy; the Cosign workflow-repository flag checks owner/name, not immutable repository ID.
Require predicate.producer.repository, workflow, workflowRef and sourceRevision to match policy and the verified certificate workflow claims.
Require run source revision to match the attested workflow SHA.
Validate predicate schema, evidence class/tier, scope, validity interval, materials/calibration digests, measurement units, uncertainty, limitations and consumer claim policy.
Emit a new verifier receipt only after every cryptographic, trust-root, identity, subject and semantic gate passes.
prohibitions: Do not use a mutable branch name as the sole signer policy.
Do not allow a broad identity or issuer regular expression in production.
Do not accept missing/expired/unknown trust-root freshness.
Do not treat command exit zero as a complete manufacturing evidence admission until post-Cosign predicate semantics have been checked.
Do not treat the deprecated --offline flag as a substitute for supplying and validating a current trusted root.
